bayts.text: My writing gladdens the Messenger of Allah for a Mawlid that lasts for us as gladness, granting the best watering-place.
My God protected me from all harm, by the standing of him for whom (is), forever, my writing, instead of idle talk and the corrupter.
Muḥammad, the Chosen: his like has not come, nor will one like him come: what an excellent master is mine!
My aim from the Master came to me without harm, by the standing of the intercessor of the worlds, Muḥammad.
I have trusted in the Lord of the Throne, His slave through him, and my heart has never ceased to be bound to good pleasure.
For the best of creatures (there is) from my pens glad tidings, and he led to me a distinction by which the soul is guided.
Its being, for the best of creation, a vessel that encompassed all lordship, called me to bring this month to life.
Our gifts become clear with Allah forever, and from us has been effaced whoever calls to following the people of vain play.
Our desire has turned toward the Truth, and the Truth is our religion, with the service of the rightly-guided one who guided every guided one.
Toward others than us all corruptions make their way, and good things make their way to us, from the best of helpers.
I have driven away toward other than Allah what does not befit Him, and my Lord has driven away toward others than me, forever, my envious ones.
To Allah, through the Chosen, I have turned that by which I obtained a clear, pure water, the best watering-place.
